title: devstack workspace (workspace.yaml)
description: The workspace root file — the shared layer: shared infrastructure services, secret providers, network/proxy/tunnel, the Docker backend, service slices, and the project list. Hand-authored per DECISIONS D16; the Go validator in internal/config is the source of truth and a CI round-trip test keeps the two aligned.

name.description: Workspace name. Used for the compose project prefix and the ledger key.

aliases.description: Alternate argv[0] names this workspace answers to.

profiles.description: The env OVERLAY selector, distinct from the service slices in `groups`.

default.description: Default overlay name. Defaults to dev. Available as ${profile}.

defaultProfile.description: The service slice `up` activates when no --profile is given (spec 12).

memoryBudgetMB.description: Warn when the active services' memoryMB sum exceeds this.

secrets.description: Providers that resolve secret:// refs (spec 04). Values are never written to generated files.

kind.description: Provider backend, e.g. sops, aws, infisical.

httpsLocal.description: Opt in to local HTTPS at https://<svc>.<project>.localhost.

backend.title: Docker backend
backend.description: Where the shared stack runs (spec 21). Omit for the local daemon. Set exactly one of context or host.

context.description: A `docker context` name, typically an ssh:// one.

shared.description: Shared infrastructure services, keyed by name. Reached over the shared network by the DNS alias shared-<name>, never the bare service name.

template.description: An engine template ref (one that declares provides:), e.g. postgres, redis, minio.

name.description: Must match the name inside that repo's devstack.yaml.

path.description: Path to the repo, relative to the workspace root.

git.description: Clone URL for `devstack ws clone`. Shorthand like owner/repo is expanded.

dsname.description: Compose/DNS-safe identifier: lowercase, starts with a letter, up to 63 chars of [a-z0-9_-].

cpus.description: Fractional cores as a string, e.g. "1.5". Must be greater than zero.

platform.description: An os/arch[/variant] selector, e.g. linux/amd64, linux/arm64/v8.

envMap.description: Literal environment variables. Values support ${env.NAME}, ${self.attr}, ${ref:...}, ${profile} and ${workspace.name} interpolation, plus secret://provider/path#key refs.

params.description: Template parameters. Accepted keys and types are declared by the template's params: block (see `devstack template list --json`).

resources.title: Resource limits
resources.description: CPU/memory/PID limits (spec 18). Lowered to BOTH deploy.resources.limits.* and the legacy top-level cpus/mem_limit/pids_limit.

memoryReserveMB.description: Soft memory reservation in MB (scheduling hint).

hook.title: Lifecycle hook
hook.description: One declarative command run at a saga phase (spec 11).

run.description: host runs via os/exec on the host; exec shells into a running service with `compose exec -T`.

service.description: Target service. Required when run: exec.

command.description: argv array — never shell-split by devstack.

once.description: Run at most once per workspace (firstRun ledger).

hooks.title: Lifecycle hooks
hooks.description: Hooks grouped by saga phase (spec 11). Lists REPLACE on overlay merge unless the YAML opts into `$merge: append`.

dockerhost.description: A DOCKER_HOST endpoint. ssh:// is the primary remote path (inherits your SSH config/agent/ProxyJump).
